macros.name: addmarriage
macros.doc: Add a marriage record to a previously defined person.

macros.name: checkregister
macros.doc: runs \checkperson on every registered person.

macros.name: child
macros.doc: \child{⟨id⟩}{⟨description⟩} typesets a child entry.

macros.name: childname
macros.doc: \childname{⟨id⟩} prints a person’s name with generation superscript, without an index entry.

macros.name: childref
macros.doc: \childref{⟨id⟩}{⟨description⟩} typesets a child entry with a “+” continuation marker, indicating that this child will appear later as a \mainperson entry.

macros.name: definepersonkv
macros.doc: The primary interface for declaring a person in the registry.

macros.name: formatparents
macros.doc: \formatparents{⟨id⟩} prints the parenthetical ancestor chain.

macros.name: generationheading
macros.doc: \generationheading{⟨id⟩} prints a bold heading such as “Third Generation” based on the person’s computed generation.

macros.name: getgeneration
macros.doc: \getgeneration{⟨id⟩} computes and prints the generation number.

macros.name: getmarriagecount
macros.doc: Expand to the number of recorded marriages for the person.

macros.name: getmarriagedate
macros.doc: Print the date of marriage ⟨number⟩, formatted through datetime2.

macros.name: getmarriageplace
macros.doc: Print the place of marriage ⟨number⟩.

macros.name: getmarriagespouse
macros.doc: Print the name of the spouse from marriage ⟨number⟩ (via \getpersonname, including index entry).

macros.name: getpersonabbrevNI
macros.doc: \getpersonabbrevNI{⟨id⟩} prints the preferred name if set, otherwise the full name, without an index entry.

macros.name: getpersonnameNI
macros.doc: \getpersonnameNI{⟨id⟩} prints the full name in small caps without an index entry.

macros.name: getpersonpreferred
macros.doc: \getpersonpreferred{⟨id⟩} prints the preferred (short) name in small caps.

macros.name: getpersonsex
macros.doc: \getpersonsex{⟨id⟩} expands to the raw stored value (M, F, or empty).

macros.name: place
macros.doc: \place{⟨text⟩} prints ⟨text⟩ in italics; \dated{⟨text⟩} prints ⟨text⟩ as-is.

macros.name: registerdatestyle
macros.doc: \registerdatestyle{⟨style⟩} changes the datetime2 date style mid-document.

macros.name: registersource
macros.doc: \registersource{⟨text⟩} produces a footnote citation.

macros.name: say
macros.doc: \say{⟨date⟩} prints “say ⟨date⟩”.

macros.name: xrefperson
macros.doc: \xrefperson{⟨id⟩} prints a hyperlinked cross-reference to a person’s main entry, showing their name and entry number.

envs.name: childrenof
envs.doc: childrenof{⟨parent-a⟩}{⟨parent-b⟩}[⟨enumitem keys⟩] is like children but validates that each \child entry has the expected parent pair.
